# Jin AI

> Make every employee your best AI user. Keep confidential data in, see how each role uses AI, and hand the best harnesses to colleagues and successors.

Status: Building. Last updated: 2026-10-19.
The workspace beta is live. Company features are being built, starting with Claude Code. Companies start with a paid pilot.

Live means available now. Building means active development. Next means intended next work. Never present Building or Next as shipped. The Human page at https://jinai.md/ is the sole canonical product page. Agent-facing formats are derivatives generated from the structured JSON fact source.

For AI-forward companies.

## AI harness

An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.

## Problem

Your best AI skills live with people, not with the company.

- Shadow AI: Your heaviest AI users already run personal AI, and work context ends up there.
- Lost at handover: When people leave, they take their AI workflows with them. No one is left knowing how they ran.
- AI training: Teaching everyone to use AI well is slow and costly. Your top performers already figured it out.

## Solution (Building)

- Safe for every employee. Put your personal context in securely, and take it out safely. Also usable in your personal AI.
- Reusable for the company. Keep confidential data in, see how each role uses AI, and hand the best harnesses to colleagues and successors.

## How it works and status

- Workspace beta (Live)
- Connect once. (Building): Jin AI connects to your AI tools through MCP. Claude Code first.
- See every harness by category. (Building): Skills, instructions, memory and MCP settings, sorted for each person.
- See it by role. (Next): Which harnesses each role uses, and how often.
- Decide what can move. (Next): Parts marked confidential connect only to the AI tools you approve.

## Your company's context stays yours.

- Each company's context is kept separate.
- Jin AI never records your screen.
- Jin AI itself never trains on your data.
